name: Lost Child: Emerald World
source:
Once, a child was lost while seeking the Emerald World. It is a world of Emerald, where everything is beautiful and wondrous.

Once, a writer wrote about the child's trip. It was a strange story, changing along with the child's trip.

Once, that was a long time ago, when a child was lost in the Emerald World.

[From [url=http://centridus.deviantart.com/art/Lost-Child-Emerald-World-A-visual-novel-367367288]official site[/url]]
